text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Satono Crown and the others were 
doing something in front of an elaborate 
contraption. Unable to resist my 
curiosity, I watched on—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And now, without further ado! A spectacle 
most bizarre in 3, 2, 1—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a flourish of the sheet, Satono 
Crown—who should have been standing right 
behind it—had vanished without a trace...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Vanishing magic, a resounding success~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! As expected, that's amazing...! To 
come up with a magic trick gimmick like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She can really pull off anything without 
breaking a sweat. Just what I'd expect 
from Cra-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's only thanks to everyone's 
help! Thanks to you too, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I was just following... 
Crown-san's instructions... so... M-More 
importantly—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Was Kris S-san also... helping 
Crown-san...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I invited Kris S-san to be 
our audience, saying, "If you're 
interested!"♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I thought having someone watch would help 
sharpen our focus and lead to a better 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Kris S-san! Your 
presence brought just the right amount of 
tension!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It was a good... performance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! Please come again anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let's pack this up quickly!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'll help too! It's pretty big, so it 
must be tough on your own, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the offer♪ But this contraption 
is designed to fold up compactly with just 
one button.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the moment Satono Crown put her 
hand on the device—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BANG!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an explosive pop, a storm of confetti 
was launched directly toward Symboli Kris 
S—!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, wha... Whawhawha—............!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, Kris S-san!! Are you 
hurt—...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ————Are you two.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! I'm sorry, I'm sorr—!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Caught in it—? —In the blast.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
W-We're fine! But... I am truly, truly 
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why... It's always with things 
like this that I tend to mess up...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Accidents... cannot be predicted. It is 
best... to learn from it next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, cleaning—... Cleaning 
up. We must—clean this mess.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, please rest, Kris S-san! I'll take 
care of the cleanup!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Inefficient. More manpower—is better.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And... one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thanks... for the performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The confetti had spread over a wide area. 
It would probably take far too long for 
just the two of them... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...This area is... finished. 
............And—so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Do you have... business with me? ...You 
were watching. ...The entire time.
choice_data_list:
I just thought you're a great 
upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Do you have... business with me? ...You 
were watching. ...The entire time.
choice_data_list:
I just thought you're a great 
upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I do not understand. The definition—is 
vague.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However... I appreciate—the praise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, without changing her 
expression in the slightest, she continued 
cleaning up systematically.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It is normal. ...If I have no prior... 
personal obligations, I comply.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That is my stance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this academy, she might end up having 
quite a tough time. Hopefully she doesn't 
push herself too hard...
